definitions.explanation: Progress to a higher level or better state.

examples.japanese: {技術|ぎじゅつ}の{向上|こうじょう}に{努|つと}める。
examples.english: To strive for improvement in skills.

examples.japanese: {生活|せいかつ}レベルが{向上|こうじょう}した。
{向上|こうじょう}{心|しん}がある。
examples.english: To have ambition / a desire to improve.

notes:
{向上|こうじょう} means improvement or advancement toward a higher level. From {向|む}かう (to head toward) + {上|じょう} (up).

USAGE AS VERB:
{向上|こうじょう}する: to improve (intransitive)
Note: Unlike {改善|かいぜん}する which can be transitive, {向上|こうじょう}する is typically intransitive.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {技術|ぎじゅつ}が{向上|こうじょう}する: skills improve
- {生活|せいかつ}レベルの{向上|こうじょう}: improvement in living standards
- {向上|こうじょう}を{目指|めざ}す: to aim for improvement
- {向上|こうじょう}に{努|つと}める: to strive for improvement

KEY COMPOUND:
{向上|こうじょう}{心|しん}: ambition, drive to improve oneself. A positive trait emphasizing self-improvement.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {改善|かいぜん}: improvement (fixing problems)
- {進歩|しんぽ}: progress (forward movement)
- {発展|はってん}: development (expansion/growth)
